name: SV Zero 1.2 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
;---SV Zero startup. See notes/incidents/2026-08-17-zero2-startup-crash.
;  START_PRINT owns homing, nozzle cleaning, Z calibration and bed mesh.
;  DO NOT add G28 here. Sovol's original had three homes per job.
;  Chamber control is never omitted. With activation enabled, M191 waits
;  for Orca's exact Minimal temperature and M141 sets its Target. A zero
;  Minimal skips the wait and keeps the Target; a zero Target turns
;  chamber control off entirely. Unchecked activation uses bare M191 and
;  its own 22 C minimum / 32 C target fallback.
;  SVZERO_REQUIRE names the pack version and machine mode this profile was
;  built for. On a printer without the pack it is an unknown command,
;  which Klipper reports and steps over. A different pack version prints
;  one warning. A different MODE refuses the job here, before any heater.
;  It also tells the pack that a job was sliced by an SV Zero profile, so
;  START_PRINT can say when one was not.
SVZERO_REQUIRE VERSION=2.1.1 MODE=standard
;  _PREFLIGHT is next so a rejected job costs no heating. It is inert
;  unless the optional spool_guard extra is installed.
_PREFLIGHT
M140 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
{if activate_chamber_temp_control[0]}
{if chamber_temperature[0] > 0}
{if chamber_minimal_temperature[0] > 0}
M191 S{chamber_minimal_temperature[0]}
{endif}
M141 S{chamber_temperature[0]}
{else}M141 S0{endif}
{else}M191{endif}
;>>>CLEAN_TEMP
;  The material is NAMED here; the temperature table lives in the macro
;  pack, in nozzle_brush.cfg's _BRUSH_CLEAN_TEMPS. Same division as
;  COOLDOWN_ARM below. Provenance for the curve is
;  source/filament-clean-temp.json.
;  Safe to omit: without the pack this is an unknown command and only
;  warns, and CLEAN_NOZZLE falls back to _BRUSH.retract_temp.
SET_CLEAN_TEMP MATERIAL=[filament_type]
;<<<CLEAN_TEMP
;>>>COOLDOWN generated from source/filament-cooldown.json -- do not hand-edit
;  Names the material; the RATES live in cooldown.cfg's
;  _COOLDOWN_MATERIALS, so one table serves every slicer and the spool
;  can name the material when no slicer does. Pass FINAL, CHAMBER_RATE
;  or BED_RATE here only to OVERRIDE the table for an experiment.
;  Omitting this block is safe: END_PRINT then asks spool_guard what is
;  loaded, and falls back to the default row if nothing knows.
COOLDOWN_ARM MATERIAL=[filament_type]
;<<<COOLDOWN
M190 S[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single]
START_PRINT
;>>>XY_CURRENT generated from source/model.json tiers -- do not hand-edit
;  X/Y stepper current is a print-tier setting. The print preset's Notes
;  carry it as SVZERO_XY_CURRENT=<A>A and this hands it to the pack after
;  START_PRINT, so homing and probing keep printer.cfg's current. The pack
;  only lowers it, and END_PRINT and CANCEL_PRINT restore printer.cfg's.
;  A preset without the marker (Draft) keeps the printer's own. Without
;  the pack it is an unknown command, which Klipper reports and steps over.
{if notes=~/.*SVZERO_XY_CURRENT=2[.]4A.*/}SVZERO_XY_CURRENT CURRENT=2.4{endif}
;<<<XY_CURRENT
;  SVZERO_NOZZLE_GROWTH offsets Z for the nozzle being hotter at the first
;  layer than when START_PRINT took the Z reference. On as published;
;  SAVE_VARIABLE VARIABLE=nozzle_growth_mm_per_c VALUE=0 turns it off.
;  Without the pack it is an unknown command, which Klipper reports and
;  steps over.
SVZERO_NOZZLE_GROWTH TEMP=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
G90
G1 Z5 F600 ; clearance from the freshly calibrated bed before any XY move
SET_GCODE_OFFSET Z_ADJUST=-0.00 MOVE=1
M104 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
M109 S[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer]
PURGE_LINE VOL_MAX=[filament_max_volumetric_speed] FIL_D=[filament_diameter] NOZZLE=[nozzle_diameter] CLEAR={skirt_distance + skirt_loops * initial_layer_line_width + 2}
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER=[total_layer_count]
